entities.name: Ágnes Ságvári
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ágnes Ságvári was a Hungarian historian most known for her historical research on the history of the Hungarian Holocaust. After serving in the party apparatus of the state, Ságvári began her career at the Party History Institute and then became the director of the Budapest City Archives. In 1980, she was honored with the Ervin Szabó Medal for her contributions as a librarian. From 1986 to 1998, she was the chair of the department on Administrative and Comparative History of the 20th Century at Budapest University.

After serving in the party apparatus of the state, Ságvári began her career at the Party History Institute and then became the director of the Budapest City Archives. In 1980, she was honored with the Ervin Szabó Medal for her contributions as a librarian. From 1986 to 1998, she was the chair of the department on Administrative and Comparative History of the 20th Century at Budapest University.
